Name: SMAPI Chat Console
Author: MissViciousCirce
Description:
i wanted to type "i want 1 salad" in Stardew and have it actually give me a salad, then i wanted to add a little energy, skip a song, change the time, and see those little friendship messages without leaving the game. so here it is ♡

♡ things you can type

press T after loading your save, then try any of these.

♡ /smapi i want 1 salad
♡ /smapi i want 2 tickets (prize tickets)
♡ /smapi i want 500 gold
♡ /smapi i want 30 energy
♡ /smapi make it 8pm
♡ /smapi change the song

replace the item, gold or energy amount with whatever positive whole number you want. items use their in game names, including modded items. "gold" adds money, while "gold bar" gives you the item.

energy gets added to what you already have, up to your current maximum. if you only have room for part of the amount, chat tells you how much was actually restored. "stamina" works too ♡

♡ time + music

clock requests accept things like 8pm, 9:30am and 22:15, within Stardew's 6 AM to 2 AM day. changing the clock doesn't undo actions you've already taken.

"change the song" cycles through the current season's background tracks, including covers that replace those tracks. use it during normal gameplay, between events and minigames. /smapi next song works too. I use piano cover mod cirrently which you can find in my optional requirements. 

♡ the little farm updates

♡ /smapi l shows recent SMAPI log messages.
♡ /smapi ll toggles the live feed.
♡ /smapi l f shows recent friendship messages.
♡ /smapi ll f shows friendship messages as they come in.

you can also add a mod name to filter for that mod. the viewer shows messages your game and mods already log. you can still use regular console commands by putting /smapi in front. type /smapi help for the shortcuts and available commands.

♡ requirements + installation

Stardew Valley 1.6.15+, SMAPI 4.5.2+, and the Console Commands mod that comes with SMAPI.
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400

close the game, extract SMAPI Chat Console into Mods, then launch through SMAPI. Vortex users can install the ZIP, enable it and deploy. fully restart after updating.
